div.div:
Reading this map:
• crow's foot at the many end — one fleet, many vehicles
• the seed script declares no FOREIGN KEYs; the app relies on these grains
• dashed line / dashed table = not a key link: spatial join, denormalized copy, or created later
• vehicles_by_region is deliberately skewed: ~60% of rows have region = 'NA' (Lab 6)
• row counts are the seeded volumes in db/coordinator-init/00-init.sql
